messages:
miguel: kicking off the rollout window 04:00-06:00 UTC for runtime v2.13, router v1.9, api v3.2. need cross-service handshake + clear rollback criteria.
elaine: noted. console has a minor schema change in the settings endpoint that requires api v3.2 contract. can we hold console deploy until api is stable?
chris: runtime has a KV cache migration that can NPE under load — plan to run runtime canary at 5% traffic and warm router before shifting.
miguel: proposed sequence: 1) router warm-up (route affinitization) 2) runtime canary 5% 3) api v3.2 canary 10% 4) console toggle. any objections?
elaine: +1 to sequence. add feature-flag gating for console toggle and patch-backwards compatibility check.
dev-bot: deploy-bot: started job rlf-2024-1717501234 (router warm-up). logs: 
```
> /deploy router v1.9 --warmup 10m --check health
warmup: 3/10 nodes warmed
health: all probes passing
```
sre-oncall: holding on automated router -> runtime traffic shift until we validate p50/p95 latencies in new region. set alert if p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.8% in 5m window.
miguel: rollback criteria (canary): any of these -> rollback immediately
- p95 latency increase >= 100ms above baseline for 3 consecutive minutes
- error rate > 0.8% sustained over 5 minutes
- tail OOMs or KV migration failures on >1 node
rollback steps (quick):
```
# router
kubectl apply -f router-previous-config.yaml
# runtime
/infra/scale-runtime --to 0 --pool runtime-v2.13
# api
/ops/feature-proxy enable legacy-api-proxy
```
chris: addendum: ensure KV-migration watchdog is disabled before scale-down to avoid split-brain.
elaine: test-coverage note: run api contract smoke with console toggled off: `/tests/smoke api-v3.2 --console=false`
miguel: ok. I'll be release lead. @sre-oncall you have final rollback sign-off if alerts trip. dev-bot, post status updates every 2m in this thread.
dev-bot: acknowledged — I'll ping updates and failed-check alarms here :bell:
sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring; if we see p95 > 300ms I'll flip the emergency route and call for rollback. ping me directly if you want manual rollback.
chris: deploying runtime canary now, 5% traffic -> starting observability checks.
miguel: good luck. keep messages short here — we'll execute rollback if any automated guardrails fail. :thumbsup:
